description: This PHP class defines a configuration for a menu related to job categories within the OrangeHRM system. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and overrides the screen for the job category module.

classes.name: JobCategoryMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A menu configurator class responsible for setting up the menu for the job category module by overriding the screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module and screen to 'jobCategory' and returns null.
